testCases.label: Create Dictionary from Lists
testCases.description: Ensures create_dict_from_lists correctly pairs keys and values into a dictionary.

testCases.label: Clear Dictionary
testCases.description: Verifies clear_dict removes all entries from the provided dictionary.

testCases.label: Copy Dictionary
testCases.description: Checks that copy_dict returns a new dictionary with identical key/value pairs.

testCases.label: Get Value by Key
testCases.description: Ensures get_value returns the correct value for a key or None if the key does not exist.

testCases.label: Get Dictionary Items
testCases.description: Validates get_items returns a list of key/value tuple pairs from the dictionary.

testCases.label: Get Dictionary Keys
testCases.description: Checks that get_keys returns a list of dictionary keys.

testCases.label: Remove Key
testCases.description: Ensures remove_key deletes a key from the dictionary and returns its value, or None if absent.

testCases.label: Get Dictionary Values
testCases.description: Verifies get_values returns a list of all values in the dictionary.
